analysis.session_summary: Overnight trade showed broad USD depreciation: the dollar index fell 0.205% and USD ranked weakest among majors. NZD (+0.531%) and AUD (+0.251%) led, closing at their best, while EUR, JPY, CHF and CAD all held tight ranges. No single driver explains the tape; most legs lacked a clear catalyst, though Fed Warsh headlines coincided with later USD-selling. BOE Bailey and BOC Macklem speeches were muted and left no policy imprint.

themes.theme: Broad USD softness with high-beta outperformance
themes.evidence: DXY/USD -0.205%; USD basket -0.306%; AUD/USD +0.557%; NZD/USD +0.840%; all closed at their best.

themes.theme: Central bank speak failed to generate directional impulse
themes.evidence: BOE Bailey basket moved 0.001% and BOC Macklem basket moved -0.021%, both inside the noise floor; Fed Warsh was unscored with a 0.051% USD impulse but later Warsh headlines had USD-negative leg shares of 39-62%.

themes.theme: European currencies and JPY held range; CHF attempt rejected
themes.evidence: EUR -0.108%, JPY -0.109%, CHF -0.104%; CHF intraday peak +0.13% before giving back 100%; EUR/CHF -0.004%, CHF/JPY +0.005%.

currency_drivers.USD: Softened broadly without a clear catalyst; Warsh headlines coincided with late USD selling.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own catalyst; held its range.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own catalyst; held its range.
currency_drivers.GBP: Bailey speech produced no impulse; closed marginally higher after recovering from an early dip.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own catalyst; closed at its best as a high-beta outperformer.
currency_drivers.CAD: Macklem speech was muted; CAD was soft against most except a weaker USD.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own catalyst; early +0.13% attempt fully reversed.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own catalyst; strongest and closed at its best.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped through six uncaused legs and netted +22.1 pips; every leg had no confident catalyst, leaving USD weakness as the main prop.

polarity_reads.read: Unscored because no forecast; initial 0.051% USD impulse was not confirmed, and follow-up Warsh headlines were met with USD selling, implying the market did not reward USD.
Muted at -0.021% basket move inside noise; no CAD policy impulse, so CAD price action was flow-driven.
Muted at 0.001% basket move; GBP showed no direct policy reaction, leaving it exposed to USD flows.

scenarios.name: USD softness persists
scenarios.thesis: With an empty calendar and no catalyst to reverse the overnight USD drop, high-beta commodity currencies stay bid and USD remains offered.
scenarios.invalidation: A hawkish Fed speaker or unexpected US data pushes USD higher and reverses NZD/AUD gains.

pair_paths.rationale: Largest overnight EUR/USD leg was up 28.3 pips; without a catalyst, a retest of that extension is plausible.
AUD/USD moved 34.9 pips up across the session; continuation of commodity strength.
NZD/USD gained 44.8 pips overnight and closed at its best.
USD/JPY lost 30.9 pips overnight; USD softness points to another down leg.

scenarios.name: USD short-covering rebound
scenarios.thesis: A 0.306% USD decline with no clear catalyst leaves room for profit-taking and mean reversion if Fed comments get re-read hawkishly.
scenarios.invalidation: NZD/USD extends above 0.56543 and USD basket makes a new low.

pair_paths.rationale: The overnight EUR/USD gain of 22.1 pips is a natural retracement target if USD recovers.
AUD/USD's 38.5-pip gain is at risk of being fully retraced.
USD/JPY's 30.9-pip decline could be reversed by short covering.

scenarios.name: Range-bound consolidation
scenarios.thesis: Several majors held their ranges overnight and the calendar is empty, favoring tight two-way trade before the next session.
scenarios.invalidation: A high-impact headline or central bank surprise produces a range break.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD posted a 36.5-pip range overnight; an empty calendar argues for repetition.

risks.watch: Further Fed Warsh, Hammack, Goolsbee commentary.

risks.why_it_matters: AUD and NZD closed at their best and are exposed to a sharp reversal if risk appetite fades or EU-China trade rhetoric escalates.

risks.why_it_matters: Most legs had no clear cause, making directional signals unreliable and stops vulnerable in thin Asia liquidity.
